name: Pledging
overview: Scripture addresses pledging as a serious matter involving personal integrity and accountability. Amos 2:8 illustrates the practice of using pledged garments as collateral, highlighting the tangible consequences of pledges. In the New Testament, Jesus and James emphasize the importance of truthful speech without reliance on oaths or pledges, teaching that one's word should be reliable without swearing by heaven or earth. This underscores a Christ-centered call to honesty and faithfulness in all commitments, avoiding the pitfalls of false or conditional promises.
